segments.title: PRODUCT / PRESENTATION — Operations Overview
captions: Recurring work needs clear ownership, proof and timely follow-up. Google Sheets is the operating interface.
This is the polished presentation workbook: four fictional employees, with daily, 7-day, 15-day and 30-day assignments.
Its counts and due dates read actual backend state. The separate private QA environment appears later.

segments.title: PRODUCT / PRESENTATION — Authenticated employee workflow
captions: Employees use Ops Tasks → My tasks. The sidebar shows assigned work, its due date and the required proof.
Employee A is the project owner’s verified Google login. This daily task requires a report, not a Ticket ID.
The report records meaningful completed work, pending work and count, and blockers. This is fictional demonstration work.

segments.title: PRODUCT / PRESENTATION — One meaningful daily report
captions: The employee reports what was completed and what remains pending. Here, three fictional portal tasks remain open.
Blockers and optional remarks are recorded with the same submission. No second spreadsheet update is required.
Business time is simulated: 21 October at 16:00 India time. Authentication and execution time are real.

segments.title: PRODUCT / PRESENTATION — Genuine first completion
captions: Submit completion is clicked once. This is the genuine first presentation submission recorded for this walkthrough.
Typing pauses and the backend wait are shortened by cuts. The following view shows the actual resulting records.

segments.title: PRODUCT / PRESENTATION — Completion recorded automatically
captions: Daily 21 October is Completed. Its proof is recorded and the action source is AUTHENTICATED.
The other three employees retain separate assignments. No dummy employee is silently authenticated as Employee A.

segments.title: PRODUCT / PRESENTATION — Activity History
captions: Activity History contains exactly one completion event from that submission, with the verified employee role.

segments.title: PRODUCT / PRESENTATION — Next daily cycle
captions: Daily 22 October now appears Pending alongside the completed 21 October cycle.
Daily work is generated independently each working day. Periodic tasks create linked next cycles on completion.

captions: All eight integrated assignment cases passed against private QA. The 22 local checks are separate supporting regressions.

segments.title: HANDOFF — Product, evidence and deployment boundaries
captions: A company deploys with its own Google accounts, credentials, recipients and access-separated employee interfaces.
This shared workbook is an administrative/reviewer demo. Private QA stays private. The owner decides whether to submit.
